identity_policy: Captured dirty source manifests identify measured inputs. HEAD/source-head is only an anchor, never the measured tree identity. statistics_policy: Medians of run-level measurements, not pooled p99; descriptive observations without invented significance. Instrumented, invalid and excluded legs remain distinguishable. No stable latency gate closure, matched offered-load native parity, or global runtime tuning claim.
